desc:
Traditionally, this was the most common joseki and was considered a typical solid combination. (See Yilun Yang, *Fundamental Principles of Go*, p. 40.) After AI appeared, this pattern virtually disappeared in professional play. See [Yeonwoo Cho, *Joseki recommended by AI*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BUetCMEW4Cc&t=53).   

However, for double-digit kyu players, this can still be a good choice.
